Hi Sophie -

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Recap
- Use case: realtime inference for internal search and answer-generation (latency sensitive)
- Expected ramp: pilot (Q1) -> production (Q2), initial spend estimate ~$30k/mo if we scale to production
- Technical: SOC2 required, SSO planned, private deployment NOT needed for pilot

Procurement / commercial items we discussed
1) Billing method: PO preferred for enterprise, but card ok for initial pilot (we can cap pilot spend).
2) Marketplace: you mentioned interest in AWS Marketplace to speed procurement - would that be your preferred path?
3) Paper: W-9 and vendor form for Redwood; SOC2 attestation for security.
4) Timeline: you mentioned a 4-6 week procurement window once paperwork is in flight.

Attachments I can share now: draft SOW, SOC2 attestation, and a pricing estimate for the pilot. See attached: Redwood-SOW-v1.1.pdf; SOC2-Attestation-2027.pdf; Pricing-Estimate-LumenAI.xlsx.

Next steps
- Sophie: please confirm billing route (PO via AP vs card for pilot) and who in procurement/finance we should loop in.
- Sophie: confirm whether AWS Marketplace (Private Offer / SaaS listing) is preferred to streamline approvals.
- Redwood (Marissa + me): we'll prepare a concise mutual-action plan and a clean SOW + Private Offer template if AWS Marketplace is desired.

If easier, happy to set a short 30-min call with your procurement/finance and our finance lead (Marissa) later this week.

Thanks -
Camila
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

From: Sophie Leland <sophie.leland@lumenai.com>

Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - procurement & AWS Marketplace (follow-up)

Camila -

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Short answers below:

Billing: our procurement policy prefers a PO for any contract over $10k/mo. For pilots under $15k total spend, corporate card is acceptable.
Marketplace: yes - AWS Marketplace is our preferred procurement path. We use Private Offers tied to our AWS account for SaaS purchases where possible. That typically shortens legal review.
Paper: please send W-9 and vendor setup form to Aisha (cc'd) - she owns vendor onboarding. Also include your standard SOW and a short summary of support/SLA.
Timeline: given internal approvals and procurement queuing, expect ~4-6 weeks after vendor form + SOW are submitted.

Procurement contact: Aisha Roy (aisha.roy@lumenai.com) is looped - she'll be the one to accept vendor forms and manage the PO.

We definitely want the pricing estimate you attached. Please also let us know if Redwood can initiate the AWS Private Offer (we prefer vendors to push the initial offer so our procurement team can accept it in the Marketplace console).

Appreciate it - happy to schedule the finance sync on 11/18 as a placeholder.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Product
LumenAI

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - procurement & AWS Marketplace (follow-up)

Thanks Sophie - great, that all makes sense. A couple clarifications and options so your team can pick the fastest path:

1) Billing options we support
- PO / invoiced: standard enterprise flow. Net 30 invoices tied to PO. Can invoice monthly or milestone-based per the SOW.
- Card: good for short pilots up to $15k; we can cap spend on the account.

2) AWS Marketplace path
- We can publish a Private Offer (SaaS entitlements) that you accept in the AWS Console. Private Offer flow typically removes manual vendor onboarding steps and accelerates purchase approvals on your side.
- Alternative: classic vendor setup + PO to Redwood (longer for legal/finance).

3) Docs we attached (see files): Redwood-SOW-v1.1.pdf (pilot scope + deliverables), SOC2-Attestation-2027.pdf, Pricing-Estimate-LumenAI.xlsx (includes both marketplace-eligible SKU ranges and invoiced pricing).

4) Next steps I propose
- We put together a 1-page mutual action plan (Marissa will own) and a short AWS Private Offer stub that you can share with Aisha.
- Marissa: I'll hand the pricing and marketplace SKU questions to you to finalize the Private Offer numbers.
- If you want us to initiate the Private Offer, confirm the AWS account id we should target and any PO-level terms required.

If it helps, Jonas (cc) can jump on a call to go through the AWS Marketplace flow end-to-end with your procurement team.

Happy to set the finance sync 11/18 - what time works for Aisha?

Thanks,
Camila
